units.source_text: 我用鉛筆在信箋上把上面這段留言的字寫得很大，

en.t: I wrote the words of the message above in large letters on the stationery with a pencil,

units.source_text: 然後又寫下堀木的姓名和他位於淺草的住址，便悄悄溜出了比目魚的家。

en.t: then I also wrote down Horiki's name and his address in Asakusa, and quietly slipped out of Hirame's house.

units.source_text: 我並非因為反感比目魚的說教才逃了出來，

en.t: It was not because I resented Hirame's sermon that I ran away,

units.source_text: 正如比目魚所說的，我是一個沒有人生目標的男人，未來的打算也沒有任何著落，

en.t: just as Hirame had said, I was a man with no goal in life, and I had no prospects at all for the future,

units.source_text: 若繼續待在比目魚的家充當食客，是很對不起比目魚的。

en.t: and if I went on staying at Hirame's house as a dependent guest, I would be terribly unfair to him.

units.source_text: 萬一我真的奮發圖強，明確目標，可每個月還得讓並不寬裕的比目魚來資助我重整旗鼓，

en.t: Even if I truly roused myself and set a clear goal, I would still have to let Hirame, who was hardly well off, support my fresh start every month,

units.source_text: 一想到這個，我就痛苦難堪，內心極度不安。

en.t: and when I thought of that, I felt painfully ashamed and deeply uneasy inside.
